---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like.

## Problem / Motivation
What problem does this solve? Why is this feature needed?

Example: "I'm always frustrated when..." or "It would save time if..."

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working.

### User Interface
Where would this feature appear in Blender's UI?
- [ ] Sidebar panel (N-panel)
- [ ] Operator (F3 search)
- [ ] Menu item
- [ ] Addon preferences
- [ ] Pie menu
- [ ] Other: ___

### Workflow
Describe the step-by-step workflow:
1. User does X
2. Addon responds with Y
3. Result is Z

## Alternatives Considered
Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds?

## Mockups / Examples
If applicable, add mockups, sketches, or examples from other addons/software.

## Additional Context
- Is this for a specific use case or workflow?
- Are there similar features in other addons or software?
- Would you be willing to help implement this?

## Priority
How important is this feature to your workflow?
- [ ] Critical - Can't use addon effectively without it
- [ ] High - Would significantly improve workflow
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Minor improvement
